newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA GOVT APPOINTS NEW JUSTICE TO HIGH COURT.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA GOVT APPOINTS NEW JUSTICE TO HIGH COURT.

text.p: The Australian government said on Tuesday it would appoint Kenneth Hayne as a justice of Australia's peak legal body, the High Court.

Attorney-General Daryl Williams said in a statement Hayne, 52, would replace Daryl Dawson, who retires earlier than expected on August 15. Hayne is currently a judge of the Supreme Court in the state of Victoria.
Hayne's appointment is the first of three upcoming appointments with Justice John Toohey and chief judge Gerard Brennan also planning to retire soon.
